context: Group gathers for a casual rooftop evening; many voices casual.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: こうやって、屋上で過ごす夜、本当に好き。
lines.en: I really love nights like this — just being on the rooftop together.
lines.style: Warm, present tone. Soft opening. Slight wonder at the simplicity of it. Breathes in gently, as if holding the moment close. Trails off tenderly at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: たまに、こうして、皆で集まると、ええなぁ。
lines.en: When we all gather like this sometimes, it's really wonderful.
lines.style: Gentle Kansai warmth. Unhurried pace. A small, satisfied smile underneath. The word 「ええなぁ」 carries quiet appreciation — not effusive, just genuine.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本当は、もっと頻繁にしたいよね。
lines.en: We should really do this more often.
lines.style: Soft sincerity underneath. A hint of wistfulness — she means it but isn't pushing. Light, conversational. Not a complaint, just a quiet wish aloud.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: だが、皆、忙しいんですよね。
lines.en: But everyone's so busy, aren't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful, matter-of-fact. No edge. Speaking what he already knows to be true, gently. Accepting without resignation. Quiet companion-like tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お互いの時間、尊重しながら、繋がっていきたい。
lines.en: I want us to stay connected while respecting each other's time.
lines.style: Calm, deliberate. Philosophical but not distant. Speaks from reflection. Breath steady. The kind of thing said softly but meant deeply. No performance — just what she's thinking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本格的な料理、用意してきたで!
lines.en: I brought real food for us!
lines.style: Bright shift — genuine cheer. Kansai lift in the energy. Quick, open delivery. Like he's been holding this small joy ready. Not over-the-top, just clear delight.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: It's gotten completely dark — that perfect dusk moment.
lines.style: Quiet observation. Almost reverent, but not heavy. Noticing what's happening around them. Soft, lingering pace. The kind of thing said half to the air.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 心、届いてる、温かい空気。
lines.en: I can feel it — the warmth in the air. It reaches the heart.
lines.style: Gentle, almost tender. Measured cadence. Soft opening. He's speaking something felt, not rehearsed. A small vulnerability under the surface. Trails with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: I really do love all of you.
lines.style: Direct, unguarded. Warm without shielding. Held breath before the word 「愛してる」. Quiet but present. She's said something that matters and she means it fully.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Soft Kansai. Small nod of recognition. Appreciating what she's just said without overstating it. Tender underneath. The quiet agreement of someone who feels it too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: こういう時間、書き留めたい。
lines.en: I want to remember times like this. To write it down.
lines.style: Earnest, writer's precision. Slow enough to mean it. Not wistful — determined. Like she's committing it to memory even as she speaks. Focused, gentle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: また、こうやって、集まりましょう。
lines.style: Soft but steady conviction. Quiet promise underneath. Not asking — stating it as something that will happen. Warm, unified tone. Eye-contact level steady.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Simple, certain. Soft agreement that feels final in the best way. Like sealing something. Warm exhale. Brief and complete.
